title: B$_{4}$SrO$_{7}$ Structure
comments:
\href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C7D2_oP24_31_a_b_a3b_b-001}{Clinobarylite, BaBe$_{2}$Si$_{2}$O$_{7}$}, is a quaternary form of this structure. 
 Space group $Pmn2_{1}$ \#31 allows an arbitrary choice of the zero of the $z$-axis.  Here it is chosen so that $z_{1} = 0$ for the strontium atom.
